zh.name: 实物带出行动清单
zh.summary: 让一本书、一杯饮品或一种器具作为动作入口，用真实物件照片说明现在可以做什么。
zh.useWhen: 对象必须对应可执行动作；区别于纯物品展示和仅写励志句子的图集。
zh.instructions: 可执行活动、对应物件、时间或准备条件、实拍图
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Object-led Activity List
en.summary: Create an Instagram list carousel using the object-led activity list structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the object-led activity list format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.
